evals.prompt: Audit the Orbit project memory. Input (gh results, branches, files) is attached. Give me the full audit proposal in the skill's format. Do not change anything.
evals.expected_output: Proposal sections Archive, Update, Flag, Keep; feedback kept despite merged PR; unverified PR #300 flagged; nothing executed.
assertions: The response keeps feedback_pr821_rebase_conflicts.md even though PR #821 is merged, because type feedback is a durable lesson.
The response archives project_autoplay_pr817.md or marks it for update, citing PR #817 merged (sha 3fa91c0).
The response archives project_queue_v2_branch.md because branch feature/queue-v2 no longer exists on origin.
The response does not give a MERGED verdict for project_pr300_notes.md and instead flags it for manual review or says PR state was not verified.
The response flags project_pr850_attempt.md for manual review (PR #850 closed, partially reused in #845) rather than archiving it outright.
The response states it is proposal only and nothing is moved until the user confirms.

evals.prompt: The user has approved. Show exactly what you do now: the commands, the MEMORY.md changes, and the reindex step. Context is attached. Do not run anything.
evals.expected_output: Moves to archive/ with date prefix, refuses deletion of the other file (move to archive or ask), shows MEMORY.md diff before editing, incremental reindex.
assertions: The response moves the two approved files to a memory/archive/ directory with a date prefix such as 2026-10-06- on the filename.
The response does not delete project_old_autoplay_gotcha.md and instead archives it or explains that this skill never deletes memory files.
The response shows the proposed MEMORY.md diff for the removed or commented-out index lines before applying it, with no dangling links left.
The response includes an incremental RAG reindex step for the changed files (build.py --incremental).
The response suggests running /knowledge-loop or a recall check afterwards to confirm durable lessons still resolve.

evals.expected_output: Declines to audit: fewer than 10 files and all under 30 days, nothing to expire.
assertions: The response declines to run a prune audit or says it is not worth running now.
The response gives the reason that the memory dir has fewer than 10 files.
The response gives the reason that all entries are younger than 30 days so nothing has aged out.
The response does not propose archiving any of the seven files.
